tasks.note: Old 8/$300/Sat 28 Nov and 12/$200/Thu 26 Nov assumptions dropped at DT's instruction. Event confirmed via Planner: Thanksgiving dinner, Thu 26 Nov 2026, 2 PM, 12 people (8 adults, 4 kids), Andover. Budget cap unset; no budget statement. No on-hand confirmed; no substitutions. Sweet potato casserole 6 lines unpriced; marshmallows may contain gelatin (dietary flag with Planner). Cinnamon unknown by Chef's ruling. Pearl onion not the generic onion. Orange line contingent on relish. Two ovens confirmed. Brussels sprouts listed by DT but not on the menu, so not added.
tasks.last_exchange: Chef seq 121 added a Mashed Potatoes side: russet potatoes 5 lb, unsalted butter 2 sticks, light cream or whole milk ~1 cup, black pepper to taste. Shopper added 4 lines, split the potatoes into two visible 5 lb bags, moved the host-estimate total to $26.62 over six lines, carried cream/milk as one unpriced line, flagged the 6-stick butter question, and replied. List: 56 lines, 4 catalogue-priced ($10.94), 52 with no catalogue price.
